text:
I don’t want to manufacture depth by interviewing each other all weekend either. If we have ten profound conversations, of course it can feel profound. I still haven’t seen what she does on a boring Tuesday or when something irritates her. Some answers only show up by waiting.

Same with the little “wait” feeling. It might be wrong. I don’t need to treat it like intuition from God. I also don’t want to erase it because I’m excited. Slow down, ask the thing I was about to avoid, and see what happens.
